terms.definition: Mass of product actually made ÷ maximum theoretical mass of product × 100.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Yield is below 100% because the reaction may not finish, side reactions happen, or product is lost when separating.

terms.definition: Relative formula mass of desired product ÷ sum of relative formula masses of all reactants × 100.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Use the balanced equation.

terms.definition: A high atom economy means less waste, so the process is more sustainable and economic.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Also consider yield, rate, equilibrium and uses of by-products when choosing a route.
